Set HVI_DW_KERBEROS environment variable enable top rung credential ladder, Kerberos integrated authentication: stored secret used, connection relies caller's existing ticket instead. read .logical(), recognises "true", "True", "T", "TRUE" (FALSE counterparts) — set one , "yes" "1", .logical() recognise silently reads NA.
